title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - MilkingSensor
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/MilkingSensor. A class to describe an animal milking sensor. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Sensor vocabulary is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. See the ex:MilkYieldSensor example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figure 7: the sensor is contained in (saref:consistsOf) an ex:Milking_Machine, measures (saref:isValueOfProperty) ex:MilkYield (a worked-example subclass of s4agri:Yield, illustrating that Yield 'can further be specialized in subclasses, such as MilkYield, CropYield, MeatYield, etc.', per clause 4.2.6) and is measured in om:liter.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MilkingSensor'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

observes.description: Property/Relationship. saref:observes / saref:isValueOfProperty. The s4agri:Property named individual this sensor measures: 'the produced amount of food for animals or of agricultural products', here specialized to milk yield (ex:MilkYield in the worked example). IRI: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Yield.

hasFeatureOfInterest.description: Relationship. saref:hasFeatureOfInterest. The Animal (or AnimalGroup) milked, e.g. ex:Cow1 in the ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1 example.

value.description: Property. saref:hasValue. The last milk-yield measurement reported by the sensor.

unitCode.description: Property. saref:isMeasuredIn. The unit of measure for 'value', e.g. 'liter' (om:liter), per the ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1 example.

dateObserved.description: Property. The date and time this measurement was made.

isSubSystemOf.description: Relationship. saref:consistsOf (inverse). The larger device (e.g. a milking machine) this sensor is a structural part of.
